# Listing 13.19: C# Equivalent of CIL Generated by the Compiler for Lambda Expressions

```

    BubbleSort(items, __AnonymousMethod_00000000);
{

        {

        }
    }

    private static bool bool __AnonymousMethod_00000000(
        int first, int second)
    {
        return first < second;
    }
}
```
